verificationScope: Two current production reports, bound to the same JavaScript and CSS, check continuous sea-breeze, cliff erosion, tide, river and GIS controls; continuous atmospheric and forest observation heights; and three independent water-cycle conditions, each with a continuous teaching sequence. They cover real geometry, stable identities and buffers, smooth seeking, frame-by-frame state agreement, direct mesh selection and dragging, stable camera framing during height changes, reverse seeking, paused refresh, native SVG switching, independent conditions, reduced motion, and sampled desktop, tablet-sized and phone-sized layouts. Thirty-seven previous reports remain baseline evidence, not a full re-test of this build.
